answer: Seat draws keyed to the beacon, redrawn each dawn. The pulse hashes into the attestation graph and picks which vertex supplies grading seats, so operators cannot predict the draw and pre-position clones. Fresh accounts start at the inlet: no seats, minimal weight; influence grows only as graded output survives spot-checks. Every grade is signed into the chain - forge-resistant, so bought history is provable and slashable. The ledge monitors watch: seat adjacency versus random baseline; clusters crossing it get slashed. Weak point: the grader set is small; expand faster than capture.
